facts.text: Detective Kimble is in charge of lunch now. Quiet voices, everybody.
facts.why: Joyce, the teacher and Dominic's mother, does not know Kimble is a detective until late in the film. The real detective partner is Phoebe O'Hara. Nobody named Penny Grant is in the film.
